how: We read the website of every New York City wedding DJ listed on Lazo (272 listings, 213 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Charleston DJ company and a Dallas-labeled site with local listings, corporate AV and talent agencies, and DJ companies more than an hour south on the Shore. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle ceremony sound and toasts in a loud city room, and do you need the venue's power or your own?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booths and overtime on top?

picks.name: Non-Traditional Wedding DJs
picks.blurb: Non-Traditional Wedding DJs in Jackson Heights play music that reflects your taste and make only the necessary announcements, none during dancing. They note they may be the only NYC wedding DJs who worked a Star Trek wedding with a Klingon fight; photo booth and lighting are add-ons.

picks.name: Dj Xenia
picks.blurb: Kseniya Stasiankova, DJ Xenia, is a Brooklyn wedding DJ for modern, non-traditional and multicultural weddings across NYC and the Hudson Valley. Originally from Belarus, she blends nightlife energy with thoughtful music curation for couples who want a music-focused day.

picks.name: TCM DJ Events
picks.blurb: TCM DJ Events in Brooklyn fields DJs with real nightlife club experience and has been featured in Martha Stewart Weddings. Couples give as much or as little input as they like through the Vibo DJ app, with time set aside to talk through the night with their DJ.

picks.name: Prive DJ
picks.blurb: Charles of Prive DJ has DJed for more than 20 years and MCed for more than 15, with hundreds of weddings and international club sets behind him. The hand-selected team works weddings, mitzvahs and sweet sixteens across New York, New Jersey and Connecticut.

picks.name: Disaronno Events
picks.blurb: Joey Disaronno has run Disaronno Events in Staten Island since 2008: eighteen years, five hundred weddings, DJ, MC and full production in-house with one contact and one invoice. The site's plain-facts page even tells you how to verify its claims.

picks.name: West Indian Dj
picks.blurb: DJ Mike and the Majestic Sound Crew in South Richmond Hill have entertained the Guyanese, Caribbean, American and South Asian communities for 16 years, with deejays, emcees, dancers, intelligent lighting and LED screens.

picks.name: DJ Jordan
picks.blurb: DJ Jordan Entertainment has specialized in upscale Jewish, Israeli, Persian and Moroccan weddings across New York since 2006. The Great Neck company builds DJ and MC, ceremony sound, lighting, live musicians and booths into one coordinated production.

picks.name: Let Us Entertain You
picks.blurb: Let Us Entertain You has been a family-run Long Island entertainment company in Massapequa since 1976. DJ and MC packages start at $2,500 and wedding packages with photography and live photo screens at $3,000, with photo booths and a 360 booth available.

picks.name: In the Mood DJ Productions
picks.blurb: In The Mood DJ Productions has worked Long Island and NYC weddings since 1987 and performs at well over 500 events a year. The site leans on recommendations from banquet managers and catering halls, and a video division is available.

picks.name: Stolen Moments Entertainment
picks.blurb: Al Scatt founded Stolen Moments in 1955 and his sons Paul and Peter still run it from Dobbs Ferry, with emcees and DJs alongside two in-house bands and string ensembles. Music is designed around your event rather than preset packages.

picks.name: Barr Entertainment
picks.blurb: Barr Entertainment was founded in 2017 in Neptune to redefine the conventional wedding DJ, with refined, high-energy celebrations and a venue list on the site. DJs curate the playlist and the company prints its package pricing.

picks.name: Party AM LLC Fusion Indian Wedding DJs - DJ Mital Patel DJ Atish Ohm Kirpalani MC Om DJ Pratik DJ Avhik - NY, CT, MA, NJ
picks.blurb: Party AM is an Indian wedding DJ and production company in Lodi serving New Jersey, New York, Connecticut, Pennsylvania and destination weddings, with a signature baraat experience and high-energy South Asian entertainment from DJ Mital Patel and team.
